tasks.label: Build (release)
tasks.detail: Compile and deploy to the Lumina mod folder. This is the build that ships.

tasks.label: Configure (release)
tasks.detail: Re-run CMake. Required after adding or removing a .cpp, because autoCollectSources globs at configure time.

tasks.label: Configure and build (release)
tasks.detail: Use this after adding a new source file, to avoid LNK2001 on functions that are plainly defined.

tasks.label: Build (debug)
tasks.detail: Also deploys to the Lumina mod folder and overwrites the release DLL. Around 5x the size, logs at trace.

tasks.label: Which DLL is deployed?
tasks.detail: Prints size and timestamp of the live DLL. Around 987 KB is release, around 5 MB is debug.
